reviews.rationale: Whole-unit HOLD remains on this new exact input after a complete twelve-word diplomatic comparison, all clauses of complete English, the mandatory note, and real source signs. The prior assembly substitution and expanded appearance spelling are corrected: selected ያስተርኢ and ምስትጉብኤ now agree with actual135. However, final source title is still submitted as መንፈሳት, while the full original native135 and its title crop print መንፈስት: fourth fidel is ስ, not ሳ. This is an exact selected-source mismatch, not a demand to replace Spirits in the English. The full collation found the first eleven source words matching; all remaining discrepancies identified in this pass are listed in whole-unit-collation.json. English after-this, singular righteous/chosen causative agent, accusative house, assembly/possessive, from-now-on, plural negative, and name/title relations were all examined; no additional semantic discrepancy was identified. Actual full Latin297-300,1173-1174 and819-820 controls support the relevant causative, assembly and hindering senses, but a correct meaning does not license normalizing a printed source fidel. The revised anchored note handles the two prior issues but cannot cure this remaining title mismatch. No caveat-only approval, silent correction, new blind actor or approval of any other unit is given. A further exact packet must retain the actual title orthography before whole-unit approval can be considered.
